archive.purpose: Minimum retained complete input/response/audit chains for 102 accepted full readings, final actual samples, source/decision evidence and delivery/browser/recovery receipts. No old-history database, temporary full install registry or preview runtime.
archive.retention_until: Retain through user acceptance and independent review; after both, assess retention of raw calls separately. No automatic reimport into formal method history.

additional_archive.retention_until: User acceptance and separately owned review finish; then assess necessary trace retention
